title: Position: Societal Impacts Research Requires Benchmarks for Creative Composition Tasks
reasoning: The paper is a position paper centered on societal impacts research and the ethical evaluation of AI models. It explicitly discusses and critiques benchmarks designed for harm mitigation, safety, fairness, and bias (such as BBQ and TruthfulQA) and advocates for new benchmarking paradigms to measure ethical and societal harms in creative contexts.
